scope_note: A proposed experiment register derived from the root master plan. No fixture instantiated, model installed, inference run, training run, controlled audition or cross-platform product test is represented by this file.

fixture_design.constraints: Set actual genres, languages, texts, durations, reference permissions and expected constraints before generating. The 48 slots are design counts, not existing fixture files.

required_before_execution: Candidate budget, selection rules and paid-run ceiling
Task-specific acceptance criteria and any statistical margin
Listening protocol and permitted reference-provider access
preregistration.threshold_policy: Only numeric gates already proposed in the master are reproduced here. They remain proposed planning choices. Other tolerances, budgets and margins are unset until preregistration; no observed success or failure is asserted.
preregistration.result_policy: Retain all candidates, failures, edits, conversion steps and review notes. Published capability claims and local measurements remain separate.

mac_control.hardware: Apple M5 Pro; 48 GiB unified memory, verified by root host inventory
mac_control.purpose: Control/development and supported Apple local runners

windows_target_pending.hardware: User reports Windows access; CPU/GPU/RAM/device specifications not yet supplied

linux_target_pending.hardware: User reports Linux access; CPU/GPU/RAM/device specifications not yet supplied

cuda_render_conditional.hardware: Actual suitable NVIDIA inventory or separately authorized bounded rental required

ace_task_profiles.tasks: Select documented base/turbo/XL capability per experiment; no universal task support assumed

minimax_quality_conditional.requirements: CUDA path and intended-use community-license conditions

blind_level_matched.protocol: Private anonymous auditions; randomized presentation; no heavy corrective mastering; full songs and problem intervals
blind_level_matched.aggregation: Cluster uncertainty by brief; report objective diagnostics separately

codec_native_roundtrip.protocol: Selected model’s exact compatible codec at native configuration; no silent codec swapping

working_pcm_preservation.protocol: Immutable pre-edit working PCM, same sample rate/channel layout/dtype; compare samples outside explicit edit/crossfade masks

faithful_separation.protocol: Pinned supported separator; preserve mixture, estimated stems and residual; no generative repair in this lane

reperformance.protocol: New reference-conditioned or score-rendered performance; explicitly different provenance from faithful extraction

singing_identity_routes.protocol: Native reference conditioning, supported authorized adapter and conversion evaluated separately

score_human_production.protocol: Original score/MIDI, authorized performance and permitted instrument renderers; log human labor

adapter_research_conditional.protocol: Rights-cleared data and supported recipe; disjoint performer/work/recording-family splits; no training authorized by this register

voice_service_conditional.engines: Selected permitted Qwen3-TTS/Chatterbox/CosyVoice candidates after exact component review
voice_service_conditional.protocol: Separate approved narration service; stable reusable voice prompt and paragraph/chapter manifests

cost_accounting.protocol: Actual charges/energy and explicit labor/ownership allocations divided by approved finished hours; no historical savings assumption

daw_export_roundtrip.protocol: Aligned dry/processed stems, MIDI and tempo map; identified DAWs on actual target systems

job_recovery.protocol: Separate artifact/project state from worker/job state; preserve hashes and terminal disposition

experiments.hypothesis: Two pinned engines can satisfy one reproducible artifact contract on supported hardware before a studio interface is built.
required_assets: Twelve smoke briefs selected from the planned fixture set, not yet created
Pinned engine/code/checkpoint/license manifests
Actual machine inventory and a bounded run budget
procedure: Record hardware, backend, revision, checkpoint hash, precision and complete inference settings.
Run the proposed 12-brief smoke subset with both adapters; retain every output, error and failed attempt.
Repeat a selected run under the same recorded conditions to distinguish reproducibility from a seed promise.
measurements: Cold/warm wall time and real-time factor
Peak process/GPU memory and failure classification

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: The master’s proposed gate is two pinned adapters completing the 12 smoke briefs, with failures retained and output provenance complete.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not promote an unsupported backend, unavailable checkpoint, unresolved intended-use license or irreproducible artifact contract.

rights_notes: Resolve each selected checkpoint and dependency’s intended-use terms before execution.
A fallback engine must be explicitly identified; a substituted run cannot be labeled as the original engine.

experiments.hypothesis: An independent engine or declared selection pipeline can improve accepted full-song quality within a fair, explicit budget.
required_assets: Approved fixture briefs and lyrics
Current lawfully obtained reference outputs if provider comparison is authorized
Independent listeners and randomized blind audition sheets
Preregistered candidate counts, selection criteria and spending ceiling
procedure: Evaluate a single-candidate lane and a separately labeled equal-candidate-budget selection lane; the master’s four takes per brief is an example to settle before rendering.
Apply the same requested duration and comparable scope, retaining rejected candidates and failures.
Randomize level-matched full-song and problem-interval comparisons; report compute/wall cost separately from candidate equality.
measurements: Composition, sonic artifacts, lyrics, identity, constraint adherence and overall preference
Accepted-result rate and total cost per accepted song
Results split by use case and selection lane

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Promote a use-case route only after owner/external listener acceptance under the declared budget; choose any later noninferiority margin before listening.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not promote a universal parity claim from a pilot, unequal selection budget, mastering loudness advantage or pooled votes without brief-level uncertainty.

rights_notes: Use only original/approved lyrics and licensed references.
Provider outputs need lawful access and applicable comparison/storage terms.

experiments.hypothesis: Structured lyric and performance conditioning can improve intelligibility and expressive singing without sacrificing musicality.
required_assets: Approved sung texts with pronunciation notes and section maps
Paired briefs varying syllable density, phrasing, tempo and supported language
Human lyric auditors and singing evaluators
procedure: Compare plain prompts with structured lyric/section/performance instructions using the same engine and declared candidate budget.
Audit missing/repeated lines, consonants, stresses, breaths and word-to-note fit against the approved text.
Collect blind judgments of expression, pitch, phrasing and musicality; keep ASR diagnostics separate from human corrections.

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Use the master’s proposed pilot gate of no missing/repeated lines in accepted tracks; register language and expression criteria before larger evaluation.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Stop an instruction strategy that gains automated lyric scores while listeners reject its phrasing or timbre.

rights_notes: Keep approved wording immutable unless an authorized edit is explicitly recorded.
Avoid imitation of an unconsented singer identity.

experiments.hypothesis: Codec reconstruction exposes a fidelity ceiling that prompting or mastering alone cannot remove.
required_assets: Held-out licensed dry and mixed recordings spanning vocals, breaths, cymbals, dense mixes and stereo space
Exact codec/checkpoint pair used by each evaluated engine
Native sample-rate and conversion manifests
procedure: Encode and decode held-out recordings through each available authorized codec at its native configuration.
Compare original, round trip and generated output independently; level-match without corrective mastering.
Annotate lost transients, consonants, bandwidth, stereo image and metallic/watery artifacts; keep resampling as a separate logged operation.
measurements: Blind reconstruction preference and artifact annotations

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Advance decoder research only when held-out reconstruction reveals a material listener-relevant ceiling; preregister the later improvement criterion.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not replace a learned codec under an existing generator without a documented compatibility/adaptation experiment; a 48 kHz container alone is not evidence of improvement.

rights_notes: Recording access is not training permission; this first trial is reconstruction only.
Pin codec terms separately from generator terms.

experiments.hypothesis: Authorized native reference conditioning, an authorized adapter or performance conversion can maintain a chosen singing identity across varied excerpts.
required_assets: Consented identity reference recordings and permitted-use record
Ten varied excerpts for the master’s proposed first identity gate, not yet created
Disjoint cross-style/octave/language challenge material
Original performance for conversion comparisons
procedure: Test native conditioning, supported adapter and conversion as separately labeled routes with identical target excerpts where feasible.
Keep source singer, target identity, melody and arrangement provenance distinct.
Perform blind owner/listener identity reviews and annotate timbre, pitch, diction, breath and vibrato degradation.
measurements: Identity recognition and consistency by excerpt

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Apply the master’s proposed ten-excerpt blind owner review gate, then define broader challenge-set criteria before scale-up.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not generalize one successful chorus to all voices, registers or languages; stop any route lacking consent or stable source/target provenance.

rights_notes: Require identity owner permission and allowed-use scope.
Adapter training rights and voice conversion rights are separate from model code licensing.

experiments.hypothesis: A local lyric/section repair can preserve immutable working PCM outside its explicit edit and crossfade mask while sounding musically continuous.
required_assets: An accepted dry working-PCM take and immutable reference hash
Authorized one-word and section repair requests
Sample-index edit/crossfade masks
Pinned engine profile supporting the requested operation
procedure: Record working PCM rate, channel layout and dtype before editing.
Render replacement material and copy retained original working samples outside explicit masks.
Compare canonical sample ranges rather than WAV headers; audition boundaries and verify lyrics.
Log conversion, time stretching, generative covers and final mix renders as different operations.
measurements: Outside-mask sample equality and changed-sample ranges
Boundary click/discontinuity and musical transition annotations

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: The master’s proposed preservation gate is byte-identical retained working PCM at the same rate/layout/dtype outside edit/crossfade masks, plus accepted boundaries.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Stop the exact-preservation claim if kept samples change; do not apply this gate to re-performance, stretching, conversion or mastering.

rights_notes: Use owned or explicitly editable source material.
Retain the source and edit manifest; approved lyric changes require an explicit authorized request.

experiments.hypothesis: A modern separator can produce useful faithful stems for a deliberately limited instrument taxonomy.
required_assets: Licensed ground-truth multitrack recordings and their documented mixtures
Pinned separator weights/licenses
Sparse and dense examples within the supported taxonomy
procedure: Run a baseline and a candidate separator under recorded settings.
Retain individual estimates, residual and recombined output without corrective generation.
Evaluate isolated stems and the recombination against known sources; annotate bleed, missing content and time shifts.
measurements: Wall time, memory and accepted-stem rate

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Promote only tested instruments and use cases after owner/listener acceptance; set task-specific metric tolerances before evaluation.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not infer arbitrary-instrument isolation from a four-stem result or claim clean original recordings when artifacts remain.

rights_notes: Confirm recording/stem evaluation permission and exact checkpoint terms.
Source and estimated-stem provenance remain attached.

experiments.hypothesis: Reference-conditioned re-performance can yield cleaner usable parts than extraction while changing the original performance.
required_assets: Authorized source songs and selected parts
Aligned source/stem or corrected transcription
Eligible reference-conditioned engine or instrument renderer
Matched faithful-separation outputs from MG-E07
procedure: Create a faithful extraction and a separately labeled new performance for the same requested part.
Compare notes, onset timing, articulation, identity and musical fit, then audition each in the source arrangement.
Keep the original and transformation manifest; show both results without calling the re-performance an original isolated stem.
measurements: Human correction time and accepted-part cost

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Promote re-performance only as a distinct operation when listeners accept its musical match and its changed-performance provenance is clear.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not use mixture residual or exact-PCM preservation as the success criterion for a new performance; stop if clean sound disguises incorrect notes or rhythm.

rights_notes: Reference use, transformation and performer identity permissions must cover the requested operation.
Restricted research models are not automatically eligible commercial backends.

experiments.hypothesis: Human performance and explicit score/MIDI rendering can achieve high-quality, controllable results for selected songs before broad generative parity is available.
required_assets: Original score, lyrics and arrangement
Authorized singer/instrument recordings or commercially permitted voice/instrument libraries
Editable MIDI and tempo map
Comparable full-song generated arrangement
procedure: Produce the same composition through a score/human route and a full-song-generation route, recording all human work.
Keep notes, automation, guide vocal, dry stems and mixer state editable.
Compare final arrangements and attempt the same requested lyric, instrument and section revisions in both routes.
measurements: Listener preference and musical intent adherence
Total production labor and accepted-song cost

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Promote this route for use cases where the owner accepts quality/control at the observed labor cost; agree on the acceptable cost envelope before expansion.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not present human-assisted results as autonomous generation or attribute instrument-library quality to a music model.

rights_notes: Verify recording, performer, voicebank and instrument-library distribution/training terms separately.
An instrument license permitting finished-song use may not permit training a new model.

experiments.hypothesis: Long full songs expose structure and identity drift that short samples conceal.
required_assets: Approved full-song briefs with repeatable chorus, verse evolution and purposeful ending
Section and lyric maps
Eligible engines with supported duration limits
procedure: Generate complete songs within each engine’s supported duration; keep requested versus achieved structure.
Review early/middle/final sections together and compare recurring choruses and singer identity.
Annotate verse omissions, abrupt transitions, harmonic drift, repeated filler and truncated endings.
measurements: Long-song acceptance, failure rate and cost

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Promote supported longform use cases only after full-song acceptance; define structure/timing tolerances before the trial.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not extrapolate short-clip success to full songs or silently stitch unsupported durations into an alleged native-generation result.

rights_notes: Use original/approved texts and composition references.
Record any continuation, stitching or editing as a separate transformation.

experiments.hypothesis: A rights-cleared domain/identity adapter improves held-out target uses beyond prompt/reference-only baselines without unacceptable memorization.
required_assets: Licensed training recordings with performer/work/family-separated splits
Supported adapter training recipe and checkpoint terms
Held-out briefs, identities where relevant and independent listeners
Approved experiment compute ceiling
procedure: Run prompt-only and reference-only baselines before training.
Train only supported components after data rights and split checks.
Compare adapter versus baselines on unseen recordings/styles; inspect nearest-source resemblance and retained diversity.

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Advance only if a preregistered held-out criterion improves over both baselines with acceptable memorization/regression review.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Stop for leakage, missing training permission, source reproduction concerns or a gain limited to training songs; do not claim broad parity from a narrow adapter.

rights_notes: Public availability is not training permission.
Voice, recording, lyrics, weights and synthetic-data provenance require separate entries.

experiments.hypothesis: A separate local narration service can preserve approved text, pronunciation and narrator identity across resumable longform chapters.
required_assets: A separate approved narration suite, not yet instantiated
Consented voice references
Pronunciation lexicon and text/chapter hashes
Current project content-policy audit before Sabbath Echo integration
procedure: Compare eligible local engines against a lawfully available current narration reference.
Render chapter/paragraph chunks with reusable identity prompts, then join using logged timing and loudness operations.
Audit word-for-word correctness, pronunciation, paragraph transitions and beginning-to-end identity; rerender one corrected paragraph and verify unchanged neighbors.
measurements: Human-corrected omissions, repetitions and pronunciation errors
Editorial repair time and accepted finished duration

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Promote an engine only after the approved-text pilot is accepted and current project policies/voice rights are verified; define the larger chapter criteria before expansion.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Stop on unauthorized wording changes, unstable identity, unavailable commercial terms or a project policy excluding synthesis.

rights_notes: Preserve the master’s provisional separation of licensed Scripture audio and narration; re-audit current governing files before integration.
No assumed commercial clearance from VoiceStudio’s app license or Pro purchase.

experiments.hypothesis: Measured cost per approved narration hour can identify the economic value of a local service without relying on the user-reported historical $25k figure.
required_assets: Approved narration pilot and acceptance records from MG-E12
Actual provider/local compute charges or measured energy data
Logged editing/review/operations labor and recurring-tool costs
Owner-set cost envelope before paid execution
procedure: Record all attempts, failures, repairs and human review, not only accepted renders.
Separate marginal run cost from ownership/maintenance allocation; make allocation assumptions explicit.
Divide total measured/declared costs by approved finished hours; compare like-for-like output quality and workload with the current reference.
measurements: Compute, tools, labor and operations cost components
Approved finished hours and rejected-hour ratio
Cost per approved hour and reviewer minutes per approved hour
Cold/warm throughput and sensitivity to rerender rates

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Promote a future cost claim only when supported by observed accepted-hour quality/cost and owner-agreed accounting inputs.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not infer savings from software price, raw generated duration or an unverified historical invoice; stop paid runs at the pre-agreed ceiling.

rights_notes: Commercial output rights must be cleared before using approved hours in a business workflow.
Historical user-reported expenditure is context, not verified billing evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: One project/control application can maintain responsive, reliable audio transport across Mac, Windows and Linux while generation runs separately.
required_assets: Eight aligned test tracks and a persisted test project
Actual three-OS machine/device/backend inventory
Instrumentation for audio underruns, UI latency and loopback where available
Background render workload supported by each machine
procedure: Play the proposed eight-track workload for 30 minutes on each target OS using actual audio devices, while background generation operates through workers.
Measure UI input latency and audio underruns; record driver, sample rate and buffer size.
Test seek, loop, solo/mute and device changes; measure microphone/controller round trip separately when hardware is available.
measurements: UI interaction p95 and audio round-trip latency

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Use the master’s proposed first gates of eight tracks for 30 minutes per OS without observed underruns and UI interaction p95 below 100 ms during background generation.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Do not call three-platform ready from one OS, headless export or a browser latency hint; record untested devices as untested.

rights_notes: Use rights-cleared audio fixtures.
Audio backend/plugin distribution licenses need review before packaging.

experiments.hypothesis: Manifest-based aligned stems and tempo/MIDI data survive a three-OS DAW round trip without timing loss.
required_assets: An accepted project with dry/processed stems, MIDI, tempo map and provenance manifest
Authorized DAW installations on the three target OSes
Reference working PCM and render settings
procedure: Export stems at one project rate with common zero start and frame count; preserve original/native-rate metadata separately.
Import the package into an identified DAW on each OS and verify start, end, tempo-map and MIDI alignment.
Audition dry and processed recombinations; distinguish float-format headroom from original acoustic fidelity.
measurements: Per-stem sample rate, start, frame count and offsets

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Apply the master’s proposed aligned-export gate: common project rate, zero start and frame count, with the imported DAW session staying aligned.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Stop export promotion on drift, omitted assets or ambiguous transformations; 32-bit/48 kHz packaging is not a quality result.

rights_notes: Export may redistribute samples, presets or derived performances; check the relevant library/model/output terms.
Preserve permitted-use and transformation provenance with the package.

experiments.hypothesis: Accepted takes and project state survive interruption independently of model jobs and OS-specific workers.
required_assets: A persisted creator/studio prototype and accepted/rejected artifacts
Interruptible render/cancel workloads
Project and job-state manifests
Three-OS test environments when available
procedure: Interrupt a render, cancel a queued job, disconnect a remote worker and force application restart in separately logged cases.
Reopen the project and audit accepted takes, edit history, job terminal states and asset hashes.
Resume eligible jobs without duplicating accepted outputs; retain failed attempts and upgrade provenance.

stop_or_promote_rule.promote: Use the master’s proposed recovery gate: forced restart preserves accepted takes and project state; later interrupted-render/cancel/upgrade tests span the three OSes.
stop_or_promote_rule.stop: Stop promotion if cancellation corrupts originals, accepted files disappear or a failed job is reported as successful.

rights_notes: Recovery must retain source permissions and revocation/retention records.
Test fixtures must not contain unapproved private voice recordings.
